instruction: Create area charts for each order showing the cumulative sales trend from Jan to Mar, and embed them in the Chart column.

metadata.explanation: This task requires creating inline area charts within cells, similar to sparklines but showing cumulative trends. Verifying the presence, type, and data source of embedded chart objects in individual cells programmatically is not reliably achievable. Marked as infeasible.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly marked as 'infeasible' - this is the appropriate designation for this task
Task requires verifying in-cell embedded area chart objects in LibreOffice Calc, which is not supported by available getter functions
No existing OSWorld infrastructure can extract chart object properties (type, data source, placement) from individual cells
The metadata explanation accurately describes why verification is infeasible
Using 'infeasible' is semantically correct when verification requirements exceed available evaluation capabilities
